name: sdd-engineering
description: Spec Driven Development: spec → options → plan → implementation → verification, with a run-plan entry point and a workflow retro

specs_dir.title: Specs directory
specs_dir.description: Folder, relative to the repository root, where feature specs are written (default: specs)

plans_dir.title: Plans directory
plans_dir.description: Folder, relative to the repository root, where brainstorm briefs and development plans are written (default: docs/plans)

retro_ledger.title: Retro ledger file
retro_ledger.description: Markdown file that workflow-retro appends one row per measured run to (default: docs/retros/ledger.md)

check_commands.title: Check commands
check_commands.description: Commands the implementer and the verifier run to check the code (type check, tests, lint), one per entry. Empty: use the plan's Verification section

architecture_checks.title: Architecture check commands
architecture_checks.description: Commands the architecture reviewer may run as mechanical checks (an architecture linter, a boundary check), one per entry. Empty: none are run
